label: VERIFIED
extraction: Delivery Gate rationale and distinction from self-audit. Claude Code's built-in checks cover code quality (build -> type -> lint -> test). Different failure mode: agent produces working code while session hygiene neglected - learning not captured, rationalized shortcuts, disk running out silently. Over many 'ship and forget' sessions, human hasn't grown. This hook enforces habit: complex task -> must touch learning libraries. Distinct from self-audit: delivery-gate checks machine-verifiable facts (was learning library touched today? is disk space safe?), self-audit checks output quality across four reasoning dimensions (correctness, completeness, honesty, groundedness). Same pattern as CI pipeline gates - automated, deterministic checks that verify machine-readable facts rather than trusting self-reported status. Quality: code went through 4 rounds of automated code review (CodeRabbit + Greptile) with 9 real bugs found and fixed. Compatibility: Python 3.8+, cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux), zero dependencies beyond stdlib.
